idea-plugin.name: Flix
idea-plugin.description:
Flix language support and --Xdebug JDWP breakpoint debugging for the wstein/flix-fork Flix compiler build.

Reuses the exact same flix lsp language server the official VS Code extension downloads (no reimplementation of completion/diagnostics/hover), and the exact same FlixDebugAdapter.java DAP↔JDI bridge as this project's VS Code debug adapter, via LSP4IJ's generic LSP and DAP clients.

server.name: Flix Language Server
server.description: The Flix "Plain-LSP" server (flix lsp), resolved from the open project's flix-vendor-*.jar (or $FLIX_FORK_JAR), the same way scripts/flix-fork does.

debugAdapterServer.name: Flix (--Xdebug attach)
debugAdapterServer.description:
Attaches to a Flix program started with --Xdebug (JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-agentlib:jdwp=...), translating JDI to DAP via the bundled FlixDebugAdapter.java -- the identical adapter this project's VS Code extension uses, started here with its "--port" socket transport instead of stdio since LSP4IJ's DAP client only ever connects to a debug adapter over a socket.

After creating a "Flix (--Xdebug attach)" run configuration, you must add a *.flix mapping to it on the "Mappings" tab before breakpoints in .flix files are recognized -- LSP4IJ has no plugin.xml-level file mapping for DAP servers (unlike its LSP `fileNamePatternMapping` above), only this per-run-configuration UI step.

action.description: Runs `flix run` for the project (bound to the Flix language server's "Run" CodeLens above def main())
